goal: Survey-first skincare routine recommender with evidence grades, shown as an MVP demo.

decisions.recommendation: Rules over curated data decide products; AI only explains them
decisions.signup: Passwordless email confirmation link (single use, 15 min) plus optional Google login; sessions are signed cookies
decisions.styling: Tailwind CSS v4; design tokens in design/tokens.json generate the @theme block
decisions.newsletter: Mock only: validates and confirms, stores and sends nothing
decisions.database: Railway Postgres (users, login_tokens, consents, routines); in-memory PGlite for local dev and tests
decisions.languages: Korean and English, chosen from the browser/phone Accept-Language, with a manual switch (cookie)
decisions.consent: Popup whenever needed (terms at login, sensitive survey data at first answer, overseas AI transfer, marketing at newsletter), versioned and logged
decisions.design: Sage & Clay: warm paper background, deep ink, clay accent, sage surfaces; Pretendard body with Noto Serif KR + Fraunces headlines (all SIL OFL, free for commercial use)
decisions.legal: Terms, privacy policy and security pages in both languages (drafts) plus SECURITY.md

milestones.name: Result page with evidence badges, AD labels
Mobile landing page with animation, Login and Try-out buttons
Railway Postgres: users, tokens, consents, routines
Email confirmation-link login and Google login
Korean/English from phone/browser language, with switch
Consent popups with versioned audit log
Terms, privacy and security pages, SECURITY.md
Saved routines, account page, data export and deletion
Redesign: Sage & Clay palette and Pretendard/serif fonts
Set RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM (verified domain) on Railway, then test real email login
Optional: Google OAuth credentials on Railway
Replace sample products with cited evidence; lawyer review of legal pages; real contact address

risks: Sample data must be replaced with cited evidence before launch
Ingredient-level evidence must not be presented as product-level
Survey answers are sensitive; legal pages are drafts and need a lawyer's review, including the DeepSeek overseas transfer
Email login cannot work in production until a Resend API key and a verified sender domain are set
Affiliate income must not influence evidence grades
Consents given before signup are logged under an anonymous ID and are not linked to the account afterwards
